ops.text: Licensor owns its generic tools and know-how. Licensor grants Licensee a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, modify and sublicense for its business the deliverables developed for Licensee under Article VII(b), and the consent requirements in Article II(g) and Article VI and the license termination in Article XXI(a) do not apply to that license.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Article III leaves Licensor owning the bespoke front end and other deliverables developed for us under Article VII(b), with no licence surviving termination. We have added the fallback position expressly: Licensor keeps its generic tools and know-how, and we take a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense those deliverables for our business, disapplying only the specific consent and licence-termination limitations that would otherwise defeat it.
